title: Maple Sausage Pinwheels
subtitle: Crescent dough spirals with sausage and maple glaze baked golden.
description: Puff pastry spirals with maple sausage and cheese, baked and sliced into rounds. Sweet-savory handhelds that disappear fast from the tray.

steps.title: Make the filling
steps.instruction: Brown sausage, drain well, and mix with cheddar, maple syrup, and black pepper while warm so cheese starts to melt and bind the filling.

steps.title: Roll the dough
steps.instruction: Press crescent dough into two rectangles, sealing seams. Spread sausage filling evenly, roll tight into logs, and pinch seams closed.

steps.title: Slice pinwheels
steps.instruction: Cut each log into 8–10 pinwheels with a sharp serrated knife. Place cut-side up on parchment-lined sheet pans with space between each spiral.

steps.title: Glaze and bake
steps.instruction: Brush tops with melted butter and maple syrup. Bake at 375°F until golden, puffed, and sausage reaches 165°F in the center.

steps.title: Cool slightly and serve
steps.instruction: Rest 5 minutes so filling sets—hot maple cheese burns tongues. Serve from sheet pans or stack in a warm hotel pan for grab-and-go.

stationWorkflow: Chill rolled logs 10 minutes before slicing if dough gets soft—clean spirals need a firm log.
Bake both sheet pans on middle and upper racks, swapping halfway for even browning.
Serve with napkins stacked high—these are sticky, handheld, and popular on the way to rigs.
cleanupNotes: Use parchment on sheet pans so maple glaze doesn't weld to the metal during baking.
Soak the sausage mixing bowl immediately—maple and cheese set into a glue once cooled.
leftovers: Reheat pinwheels on a sheet pan at 325°F for 8 minutes until warmed through and crust re-crisp.
Split cold pinwheels and griddle cut-side down with extra maple for a caramelized second-day treat.

adaptable.label: Gluten-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a certified gluten-free bread/crust/wrapper alternative. Make your own blend from individually confirmed gluten-free spices, or use a certified gluten-free seasoning packet.

adaptable.label: Dairy-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Use a dairy-free cheese shred/block alternative. Use a plant-based butter/margarine.

adaptable.label: Pork-Free Adaptable
adaptable.note: Swap in chicken or turkey sausage.
